D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSix.name: D5.S3.Geometry.Orthogonality.RationalSixAxisCover.rational_six_axis_open_cover
D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSix.signature: theorem rational_six_axis_open_cover : (∀ i : Fin 6, IsOpen (color i)) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin 6) (x : UnitSphere), x ∈ color i → ∀ (y : UnitSphere), y ∈ color i → inner ℝ (x : Space) (y : Space) ≠ 0) ∧ (⋃ i : Fin 6, color i) = Set.univ
